subject: Reordering fixed effects in the formula yields different hyper parameters for the spatial field

messages.subject: Reordering fixed effects in the formula yields different hyper parameters for the spatial field
parts:
Dear all,

I'm trying to fit a ZANB model with an iid effect and a random spatial effect.
If I ran the model with 2 different ( only switching the order of two fixed effects) then the hyper parameters of the spatial field and/or for the iid effect are different.

Sadly I can not share my data, but I have created an artificial data set and an artificial domain.

I have 257 locations and between 20-30 observations per location. If two observations are from the same location then the only differ in the depended variable ( covariates are the same). Here the  data set has two covariates x and x1 which are drawn from a standard normal distribution.
I create the mu parameters of the ZANB distribution as follows:

mu =  2+x + x1 + spatial effect + iid

(I would like to have the spatial field a range of 15 and a variance of 1. I know that for the spatial field the desired properties are not coded down.)

Then draw from a ZANB distribution 20-30 times per location for the given parameters of mu, zero probability parameter and size parameter.
 How I do everything in detail is given in the code below. I have attached the code as well.

The question is, why do I get different results for switching terms in the formula?

Any help is appreciated.
Best Hannes
